entities.summary: Paul-Bernard de Fontaines, also known as Comtefontaine, Conde Fontana or Fuentes, was commander of the Spanish infantry during the Eighty Years War. He was Bailiff of Bruges and Governor of Damme. He participated in the battles around Hulst, Kallo and Antwerp.
